//ClientIds: The client IDs this API pins in its authorization rules. Each must equal the same key under ClientIds in src/IDP/appsettings.json (where the IDP registers the client); a missing one stops the start-up.
//ConnectionStrings: NotificationsDbConnection holds a password, so it is NOT in this file (which goes into the container image): Development reads it from appsettings.Development.json, everywhere else from the environment (ConnectionStrings__NotificationsDbConnection) or a secret store. Missing = the API refuses to start.
